title: ze_ATIX_panic_2077
description:
(Un)Official remake of the legendary ATIX_PANIC_2017, by ATIX.

After the events of Pepsi Islands and the assassination of Pepsi CEO (Andrei Pepsiman) by the Mobile Army of Paratroopers from Europe and America (MAPEA), the chopper that extracted you, which was later identified as belonging to Shinra Company, was hijacked by its elite agent Sephiroth, who later used domain expansion and trapped you in an endless time loop, set at the rooftop of a building owned by former PEPSI agent: John ATIX.

Will you keep overdefending zombies all to get smacked by lasers at the end? Or are you willing to break free from this purgatory?
